# Storage: only the chip's name

How sure we are: <span class="tag tag-hyp">HYPOTHESIS</span>

## What we know

The flash controller answered on two chip-enable lines and returned a chip identifier (Toshiba). Nothing else was read.

## What we guess

No guess yet: the other chip-enable lines and the second bus have not been probed, so nothing is assumed about them.

## What would settle it

A first page read through the controller. It has not been designed yet.

*This describes an experiment, not a procedure to follow: a step that writes to the phone's hardware is only run after a written description and an explicit decision.*
